review.headline: Tempo cut short at 6 km of a planned 9 km; the 5 km tempo block was run too fast and the athlete stopped early, reporting heavy legs and poor sleep.
observations: Planned 2 km warm-up, 5 km at 4:37/km threshold, 2 km cool-down; actual run was 6.0 km at 5:37/km average and stopped at 6 km.
Km 3-5 ran at 5:00/km, about 23 s/km faster than the 4:37/km threshold target, with HR 176 and cadence drop not evident; the tempo block was overcooked from the start.
Opening 2 km at 5:50/km was roughly warm-up pace, but the jump to 5:00/km was abrupt and unsustainable at the planned threshold effort.
Final km at 7:00/km and HR 159 show the athlete was fading and effectively finished the session early; the athlete's note and RPE 8 are consistent with this.
flags: Session cut short: 6.0 of 9.0 km planned, roughly 3 km missed.
Tempo pace about 23 s/km faster than target while HR reached 176 (max 179), well above the 163 average of the previous tempo at a slower pace.
Efficiency fell to 1.093 from 1.304 on the 11-03 tempo, a notable drop in pace-to-HR economy.
Reported heavy legs and poor sleep, RPE 8 for a threshold session.
Only one of seven planned sessions completed this week (6.0 of 45 km), and CTL has dropped 5.7 over 7 days.
